'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Josh Mack DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / We Will Not Go Quietly|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Remaker
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
